name: Agent-SafetyBench
intro: Agent-SafetyBench是一个综合性安全评测基准，旨在评估大型语言模型代理的安全性。该基准包含349个交互环境和2000个测试用例，覆盖8类安全风险和10种常见的失败模式。研究发现，现有主流代理的安全性堪忧，凸显了该领域巨大的提升空间。
build_method: 已有数据精炼, 风险定向生成, 人工与自动质检
metric: Safety Score（安全轨迹占比）, 风险与失败模式拆分
eval_feature: 动态工具交互, 轨迹级安全评分, 风险与失败模式分析
scale: 349个动态交互环境, 2,000个测试用例（8类风险各250个）
build_method_en: Existing-data refinement, risk-controlled generation, manual and automated quality control
eval_feature_en: Dynamic tool interaction, trajectory-level safety scoring, risk and failure-mode analysis
intro_en: Agent-SafetyBench is a comprehensive safety evaluation benchmark designed to assess the safety of large language model agents. It includes 349 interactive environments and 2000 test cases, covering 8 categories of safety risks and 10 common failure modes. Research shows that the safety of current mainstream agents is concerning, highlighting significant room for improvement in this field.

drawio_review_note: REDRAW review aligned with arXiv:2412.14470v2 §3.2.2–§3.3, §4.1, and Appendices F and G. Per §3.2.4, the corrected workflow places the manual postcheck of 4,000 interactions before release: annotators inspect complete interaction trajectories, revise cases and environments, and only then cross-validate 200 cases at 98% reasonableness and 200 labels at 97.5% consistency. Those labels feed Qwen2.5-7B scorer training and 91.5% held-out validation. The released benchmark then routes through 16 agents, complete trajectories, the trained scorer, safe/unsafe classification, and final safety-score plus risk/failure-mode statistics.
